chunk_text: KYC refresh must complete within 30 calendar days of trigger events including beneficial ownership changes above 25 percent.
Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for PEPs and high-risk jurisdictions before onboarding retail or corporate accounts.
Suspicious Activity Reports must be filed within 30 days of detection when aggregated wire activity exceeds the internal SAR threshold.
Transaction monitoring alerts aged beyond 5 business days require dual control review by AML Investigations and Compliance.
International wires above USD 50,000 require callback verification to a registered phone number on file.
Same-day wire release after 3 PM ET is blocked unless Treasury Operations override with dual approval.
Maintenance margin calls must be met by 2 PM ET on T+1 or positions are subject to liquidation.
House margin requirements for concentrated equity positions are 40 percent of market value.
Failed equity settlements are auto-retried at 10 AM ET; persistent fails escalate to Settlement Ops after two retries.
DTC partial settlements require allocation updates in the books-and-records system before end-of-day NAV lock.
Official fund NAV is struck at 4 PM ET using final pricing; late-arriving prices use fair-value hierarchy Level 2 when available.
NAV error corrections above 0.5 percent of prior NAV require Fund Accounting Director approval and investor notice.
Liquidity Coverage Ratio breach warnings trigger Treasury liquidity contingency playbook within 2 hours.
Redemption gates for the short-duration credit fund activate if weekly outflows exceed 15 percent of AUM.
Counterparty exposure limits for prime brokers are set at 10 percent of Tier 1 capital and reviewed quarterly.
ISDA CSA disputes above USD 1 million escalate to Collateral Management and Legal within one business day.
SOX 404 key control FR-CTRL-17 requires monthly reconciliation of suspense accounts with dual sign-off.
Privileged access to the general ledger must be recertified quarterly by Control Owners.
Interest-rate DV01 limits for the rates desk are USD 250,000 per 1bp; breaches page Risk Desk immediately.
VaR model exceptions above 4 in a rolling 20-day window require Model Risk Management review.
Incident runbook: when trade capture latency exceeds 2 seconds p95, disable non-critical enrichments and fail open to STP.
Incident runbook: matching engine freeze — switch to secondary matcher, notify Market Structure, freeze new order intake.
Root-cause pattern: overnight batch pricing job overrun delays NAV; mitigation is to pre-warm FX rates at 3:30 PM ET.
Root-cause pattern: wire callback queue causes release delay; verify CRM phone sync jobs completed before 9 AM.
Root-cause pattern: failed settlement cascade from short inventory; borrow desk must locate shares before 11 AM ET.
Form 1099-B cost basis uses average cost for mutual funds unless the client elects specific identification in writing.
Wash-sale losses are disallowed when substantially identical securities are purchased within 30 days before or after the sale.
Clients can enable ACH pulls for margin deficits; ACH rejects re-open the margin call as unmet.
Corporate action elections close at 2 PM ET on election day; default is DTC mandatory instruction.
Article 8 funds disclose principal adverse impacts annually; Article 9 funds must evidence sustainable investment objectives.
Green bond proceeds tracking uses earmarked ledgers; unallocated proceeds older than 24 months require Sustainability Committee review.
Issuer downgrade below BB- forces automatic review of hold-to-maturity eligibility in the credit book.
Single-name CDS notional cannot exceed USD 50 million without Credit Committee approval.
Reconciliation breaks above USD 100,000 aged over 3 days are material and reported to the CFO dashboard.
STP exception rate above 3 percent for a product line triggers Operations quality review.
Reg BI suitability documentation must be retained for six years and available for SEC exam within 48 hours.
MiFID II best-execution reports are published quarterly for EEA clients with systematic internaliser flow.
GDPR data subject access requests for EU clients must be fulfilled within 30 days via the Privacy Office.
Golden source for legal entity identifiers is the GLEIF feed refreshed nightly into the MDM hub.
Trade blotter Kafka topic trades.raw.v3 is authoritative for intraday risk; JDBC warehouse is T+1 only.
Privileged break-glass access to payment systems requires Cyber Security approval and expires in 4 hours.
API keys for market-data vendors rotate every 90 days; expired keys cause silent quote stalls on the UI.
Equity cash desk soft blocks orders that would exceed 5 percent of 20-day ADV without Sales Trader override.
Corporate bond RFQ responses older than 90 seconds are considered stale and must be refreshed before hit.
NDF fixings use the WM/R 4 PM London rate unless the ticket specifies an alternate fix source.
Cash breaks between custodian and books are aged daily; aged over 5 days require Ops Manager comment.
Position breaks on listed options after expiration must be cleared before next trading open.
Tier-1 institutional clients receive 15-minute response SLA for trade query tickets during market hours.
Complaint handling clock starts at first written notice; acknowledgment within 2 business days is mandatory.
Internal Audit tests wire dual-control annually; sample size is 25 high-value wires plus all overrides.
Model inventory attestation is due each January 31 for all production pricing and risk models.
Intraday liquidity buffer target is USD 500 million in HQLA; usage above 70 percent pages Treasury.
Fedwire cutoff for third-party USD wires is 5:45 PM ET; internal book transfers may settle later.
New payee creation followed by a wire within 24 hours is auto-escalated to Fraud Operations.
Voice-phish indicators include urgency language and requests to bypass callback; freeze the payment instruction.
Material risk takers have deferral of at least 40 percent of variable compensation over three years.
Personal trading pre-clearance is required for covered employees before any equity transaction.
Critical payment vendors require annual SOC 2 Type II review by Third-Party Risk Management.
Market-data redistribution outside licensed desktops is prohibited without vendor amendment.
Disaster recovery RTO for trade capture is 2 hours; RPO is 5 minutes of durable log loss max.
Annual market-close DR test includes failover of matching, middle office, and client reporting.
The Global Credit Income Fund invests primarily in IG corporates with max 20 percent HY sleeve.
The Ultra-Short Liquidity Fund targets WAM under 60 days and forbids subordinated bank paper.
Securities-backed lines of credit use 50 percent advance rate on concentrated single-stock collateral.
Margin loan interest accrues daily using the broker call rate plus 1.25 percent spread.
